description: Bash, Linux, Kali and systemd quick facts.

entries.text: Bash scripts: start with `#!/usr/bin/env bash` and `set -euo pipefail`; quote every variable "$var"; use $(cmd) not backticks; check with shellcheck.
Linux permissions: chmod +x script.sh to run it; ls -l shows rwx for owner/group/other; sudo only for the single command that needs it, never for pip or npm.
Find things: `grep -rn pattern dir`, `find dir -name '*.py'`, `rg pattern` if ripgrep is installed, `which cmd` / `command -v cmd` to locate a binary.
Processes and ports: `ps aux | grep name`, `kill -9 PID` as last resort, `ss -tulpn` or `lsof -i :8000` to see what holds a port, `nohup cmd &` or tmux to keep something running.

systemd service: unit file in /etc/systemd/system/name.service with [Service] ExecStart=, WorkingDirectory=, EnvironmentFile=, Restart=on-failure; then `systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now name` and `journalctl -u name -f`.
Kali/Debian packages: `sudo apt update && sudo apt install pkg`; Python packages go in a venv (PEP 668 blocks system pip). `apt search name` to find packages.
Pipes and text: `cmd | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn` for counts, `awk '{print $2}'` for columns, `sed -i 's/old/new/g' file` for in-place replace, `cut -d, -f1` for CSV fields.
Networking checks: `ip a` for addresses, `ping host`, `curl -v https://host/path` to see headers/TLS, `curl -s url | jq .` for JSON APIs, `dig host` for DNS.
SSH: `ssh user@host`, keys with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` then `ssh-copy-id user@host`; `scp file user@host:path` to copy; `ssh -L 8000:localhost:8000 user@host` to tunnel a port.
Environment variables: `export VAR=value` for the session, put them in ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc to persist, `env | grep VAR` to check; apps read them with os.environ / std::env / process.env.
